name: Centaur Vinecrasher
oracle_text:
Trample
This creature enters with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the number of land cards in all graveyards.
Whenever a land card is put into a graveyard from anywhere, you may pay {G}{G}. If you do, return this card from your graveyard to your hand.
blocked_sentences: Whenever a land card is put into a graveyard from anywhere, you may pay {G}{G}. If you do, return this card from your graveyard to your hand.

needs.what: a trigger event that fires whenever a card matching a filter (here: a land card, any owner) is put into a graveyard from ANY zone -- battlefield, hand (discard), library (mill), stack -- usable on an ability with active_zones ["graveyard"] so the card triggers while it sits in its owner's graveyard (Ashen Ghoul / Vengevine style recursion)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: leaves_battlefield with to_zones ["graveyard"] only sees permanents leaving the battlefield (a sacrificed or destroyed land) and misses discarded, milled and countered-from-stack cards; discard covers only the hand; dies is creatures only; there is no mill or generic zone-change-to-graveyard event in trigger_events. The may-pay {G}{G} and return_to_hand halves are expressible once the event exists.
